name: DangerousGoodsDeclarationChecker
tagline: Check every UN line, keep incompatible classes apart and get the DG declaration approved before cut-off.
description: Complete dangerous goods desk app for Power Apps and Power Pages: UN reference lookup (class, subsidiary risk, packing group, proper shipping name), quantity, limited quantity, EmS / tunnel code, air and cut-off checks, a segregation matrix per transport unit, ADR 1.1.3.6 points, an approval workflow with DG-specialist and four-eyes rules and a declaration text per shipment. Declaration aid only – validate against the current ADR / RID, IMDG Code or IATA DGR.
features: 49-entry UN reference + your own entries as simple text
Class / PG / name / N.O.S. technical-name checks with Apply reference
Simplified segregation matrix per transport unit (not together / separate, acids and alkalis)
Limited quantity, flash point, marine pollutant, EmS and tunnel code checks
Air checks (forbidden classes, Cargo Aircraft Only lithium, per-package limit)
ADR 1.1.3.6 points estimate per road shipment
Draft → In check → Query → Approved → Declared / Rejected with DG-specialist and four-eyes rules
Declare shipment with one declaration reference
Declaration text, CSV register and summary JSON outputs
Bulk actions, undo, drag and drop board
